description: The grouped and stacked bar chart illustrates the Bias Percentage across three different contact scenarios. The horizontal category axis displays three scenarios: "Support of Authorities", "Extended Contact", and "Virtual Contact", ordered categorically from left to right. The vertical value axis is labeled "Bias Percentage" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, with numeric tick labels at intervals of 10. Within each of the three categories on the horizontal axis, there is a group of three stacked bars. According to the legend below the chart, the left bar in each group represents "No Contact", the middle bar represents "Positive Contact", and the right bar represents "Negative Contact". Each of these bars is stacked to show "Before" and "After" values. The bottom segment of each stack represents the "Before" condition, depicted in solid colors: light grey for No Contact Before, light red for Positive Contact Before, and light blue for Negative Contact Before. The top segment represents the "After" condition, depicted in hatched patterns: hatched dark grey for No Contact After, hatched dark red for Positive Contact After, and hatched dark blue for Negative Contact After (the text for this final legend entry is obscured by a grey box, but the hatched dark blue pattern is visible). Every bar segment is annotated with its exact numeric value; the "Before" values are printed inside the solid bottom segments, while the "After" values are printed in bold text above the top of each stacked bar. In the "Support of Authorities" category, the No Contact bar has a Before value of 39.50 and an After value of 0.04; the Positive Contact bar has a Before value of 31.83 (making it the shortest total stacked bar) and an After value of 0.00; the Negative Contact bar has a Before value of 42.38 and an After value of 0.00. In the "Extended Contact" category, the No Contact Before value is 40.61 with an After value of 0.00; the Positive Contact Before value is 36.13 with an After value of 0.00; and the Negative Contact Before value is 47.28 (the tallest individual segment) with an After value of 0.11. In the "Virtual Contact" category, the No Contact Before value is 39.74 with an After value of 10.00; the Positive Contact Before value is 39.17 with an After value of 10.01; and the Negative Contact Before value is 43.83 with an After value of 10.02, making this the tallest overall stacked bar.
